name: Morimura Sakuya
source:
A gentle, quiet honor student. He is hailed as the greatest prodigy since the academy was founded. He loves nature and plant life, and is said to dream of becoming a tree doctor in the future. For that reason, he belongs to the Gardening Club. Because of his kind heart, he tends to give off a quiet, reserved impression.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
